items.question: Trong câu "The strongest predictor of team effectiveness is not the individual ability of its members, but how safe it feels to speak honestly.", từ "predictor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The strongest predictor of team effectiveness is not the individual ability of its members, but how safe it feels to speak honestly.", what does "predictor" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: something that indicates a future result
items.explanation: predictor /prɪˈdɪktə/ (danh từ): yếu tố dự báo. "The strongest predictor of X" = yếu tố dự báo X chính xác nhất; hay gặp trong nghiên cứu và báo cáo.
items.explanationEn: predictor /prɪˈdɪktə/ (noun): something that indicates a future result. "The strongest predictor of X" is the factor that best forecasts X; common in research and reports.

items.question: Trong câu "The strongest predictor of team effectiveness is not the individual ability of its members, but how safe it feels to speak honestly.", từ "effectiveness" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The strongest predictor of team effectiveness is not the individual ability of its members, but how safe it feels to speak honestly.", what does "effectiveness" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: how well something achieves its goal
items.explanation: effectiveness /ɪˈfektɪvnəs/ (danh từ): mức độ hiệu quả. "Team effectiveness" = hiệu quả làm việc của đội; khác "efficiency" (ít tốn nguồn lực).
items.explanationEn: effectiveness /ɪˈfektɪvnəs/ (noun): how well something achieves its goal. "Team effectiveness" means how well a team reaches its goals; compare "efficiency", which is about using few resources.

items.question: Trong câu "The reason is simple: bad information is withheld until it is too late.", từ "withhold" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The reason is simple: bad information is withheld until it is too late.", what does "withhold" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: withhold /wɪðˈhəʊld/ (động từ): giữ lại, không tiết lộ. "Withhold information/payment" = giữ lại thông tin/khoản thanh toán, không đưa ra.
items.explanationEn: withhold /wɪðˈhəʊld/ (verb): to keep back, not reveal. "Withhold information" or "withhold payment" means deliberately not giving it.

items.question: Trong câu "Mistakes are hidden until they surface on their own.", từ "surface" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Mistakes are hidden until they surface on their own.", what does "surface" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to coat the outer layer of
items.explanation: surface /ˈsɜːfɪs/ (động từ): lộ ra, xuất hiện. Động từ "surface" = nổi lên, lộ ra (vấn đề, lỗi); danh từ "surface" = bề mặt.
items.explanationEn: surface /ˈsɜːfɪs/ (verb): to come to light, appear. As a verb, "surface" means to become known (problems, bugs); as a noun it means the outer layer.

items.question: Trong câu "Estimates are inflated to avoid being questioned when late.", từ "inflate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Estimates are inflated to avoid being questioned when late.", what does "inflate" (verb) mean?
options: thổi phồng, nâng cao quá mức
items.explanation: inflate /ɪnˈfleɪt/ (động từ): thổi phồng, nâng cao quá mức. "Inflated estimates/prices" = ước lượng/giá bị đội lên; nghĩa gốc là bơm phồng (bóng, lốp).
items.explanationEn: inflate /ɪnˈfleɪt/ (verb): to make larger than justified. "Inflated estimates" are padded beyond reality; the literal sense is filling something with air.

items.question: Trong câu "Nobody contradicts the PM, even when the PM is clearly wrong.", từ "contradict" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Nobody contradicts the PM, even when the PM is clearly wrong.", what does "contradict" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: contradict /ˌkɒntrəˈdɪkt/ (động từ): phản bác, nói ngược lại. "Contradict someone" = cãi lại, nói trái ý ai; "contradiction" = sự mâu thuẫn.
items.explanationEn: contradict /ˌkɒntrəˈdɪkt/ (verb): to say the opposite of. "Contradict someone" means to say they are wrong; the noun is "contradiction".

items.question: Trong câu "Admit your own mistakes first, out loud.", từ "admit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Admit your own mistakes first, out loud.", what does "admit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: admit /ədˈmɪt/ (động từ): thừa nhận. "Admit a mistake" = thừa nhận sai lầm; "admit someone to hospital" = cho nhập viện (nghĩa khác).
items.explanationEn: admit /ədˈmɪt/ (verb): to confess, accept as true. "Admit a mistake" means to confess it; "be admitted to hospital" uses the sense of letting in.

items.question: Trong câu "Admit your own mistakes first, out loud.", từ "out loud" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Admit your own mistakes first, out loud.", what does "out loud" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: out loud /aʊt laʊd/ (cụm từ): nói thành tiếng, công khai. "Say it out loud" = nói to, nói ra thành lời để người khác nghe thấy.
items.explanationEn: out loud /aʊt laʊd/ (phrase): spoken aloud, openly. "Say it out loud" means to speak so others can hear, rather than just think it.

items.question: Trong câu "Shield whoever raised the problem from outside pressure.", từ "shield" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Shield whoever raised the problem from outside pressure.", what does "shield" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shield /ʃiːld/ (động từ): che chắn, bảo vệ. "Shield someone from something" = che chắn ai khỏi điều gì; danh từ "shield" = cái khiên.
items.explanationEn: shield /ʃiːld/ (verb): to protect from harm. "Shield someone from something" means to protect them; the noun is a physical protective plate.

items.question: Trong câu "If a risk-raiser gets blamed once in front of the customer, the team will remember it for a very long time.", từ "blame" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If a risk-raiser gets blamed once in front of the customer, the team will remember it for a very long time.", what does "blame" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to hold responsible for a fault
items.explanation: blame /bleɪm/ (động từ): đổ lỗi, quy trách nhiệm. "Get blamed for something" = bị đổ lỗi; "blame culture" = văn hoá đổ lỗi.
items.explanationEn: blame /bleɪm/ (verb): to hold responsible for a fault. "Get blamed for something" means being held responsible; a "blame culture" punishes mistakes.

items.question: Trong câu "Allocating by percentage of time.", từ "allocate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Allocating by percentage of time.", what does "allocate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: allocate /ˈæləkeɪt/ (động từ): phân bổ. "Allocate work/resources/budget" = phân bổ công việc/nguồn lực/ngân sách.
items.explanationEn: allocate /ˈæləkeɪt/ (verb): to distribute for a purpose. "Allocate work, resources or budget" means to assign them to people or purposes.

items.question: Trong câu "Efficient short term, but long term it creates a bottleneck and a team that never grows.", từ "bottleneck" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Efficient short term, but long term it creates a bottleneck and a team that never grows.", what does "bottleneck" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a point that slows the whole flow
items.explanation: bottleneck /ˈbɒtlnek/ (danh từ): điểm nghẽn. "Become a bottleneck" = trở thành điểm nghẽn khiến cả quy trình chậm lại.
items.explanationEn: bottleneck /ˈbɒtlnek/ (noun): a point that slows the whole flow. "Become a bottleneck" means being the single point that slows everything down.

items.question: Trong câu "Your best person burns out and everyone else learns nothing.", từ "burn out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Your best person burns out and everyone else learns nothing.", what does "burn out" (phrase) mean?
options: kiệt sức vì làm quá nhiều
items.explanation: burn out /bɜːn aʊt/ (cụm từ): kiệt sức vì làm quá nhiều. "Burn out" = kiệt sức (tinh thần, thể chất); danh từ "burnout" = tình trạng kiệt sức.
items.explanationEn: burn out /bɜːn aʊt/ (phrase): to become exhausted from overwork. "Burn out" means to become exhausted by stress or overwork; the noun is "burnout".

items.question: Trong câu "It sounds sensible but creates knowledge islands — each part understood by exactly one person.", từ "sensible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It sounds sensible but creates knowledge islands — each part understood by exactly one person.", what does "sensible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sensible /ˈsensəbl/ (tính từ): hợp lý, khôn ngoan. "Sounds sensible" = nghe có vẻ hợp lý; đừng nhầm với "sensitive" (nhạy cảm).
items.explanationEn: sensible /ˈsensəbl/ (adjective): reasonable and practical. "Sounds sensible" means it seems reasonable; do not confuse it with "sensitive".

items.question: Trong câu "Context switching has a real cost, and a person split in half usually produces less than 70 percent of what they would produce full-time on one thing.", từ "context switching" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Context switching has a real cost, and a person split in half usually produces less than 70 percent of what they would produce full-time on one thing.", what does "context switching" (phrase) mean?
options: chuyển đổi qua lại giữa việc
items.explanation: context switching /ˈkɒntekst ˈswɪtʃɪŋ/ (cụm từ): chuyển đổi qua lại giữa việc. "Context switching" = chuyển đổi liên tục giữa các việc, làm mất thời gian tập trung lại.
items.explanationEn: context switching /ˈkɒntekst ˈswɪtʃɪŋ/ (phrase): shifting attention between tasks. "Context switching" is jumping between tasks, which costs time to refocus each time.

items.question: Trong câu "An experienced person with a learner on important parts, to shrink knowledge islands", từ "shrink" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An experienced person with a learner on important parts, to shrink knowledge islands", what does "shrink" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (động từ): thu hẹp, làm nhỏ lại. "Shrink the gap/team/budget" = thu hẹp khoảng cách/đội/ngân sách.
items.explanationEn: shrink /ʃrɪŋk/ (verb): to make smaller. "Shrink the gap" or "shrink the budget" means to make it smaller.

items.question: Trong câu "State what must be achieved and why, and let the doer choose the method", từ "achieve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "State what must be achieved and why, and let the doer choose the method", what does "achieve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: achieve /əˈtʃiːv/ (động từ): đạt được. "Achieve a goal/result" = đạt được mục tiêu/kết quả; danh từ "achievement".
items.explanationEn: achieve /əˈtʃiːv/ (verb): to reach or accomplish. "Achieve a goal" means to succeed in reaching it; the noun is "achievement".

items.question: Trong câu "One primary task per person; work waiting beats a person waiting between tasks", từ "primary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One primary task per person; work waiting beats a person waiting between tasks", what does "primary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: primary /ˈpraɪməri/ (tính từ): chính, chủ yếu. "Primary task/goal" = nhiệm vụ/mục tiêu chính; "primary school" = trường tiểu học.
items.explanationEn: primary /ˈpraɪməri/ (adjective): main, most important. "Primary task" is the main one; in "primary school" it refers to early education.

items.question: Trong câu "If each person is judged only on their own slice, you have individuals working side by side, and no reason for them to help each other when somebody falls behind.", từ "side by side" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If each person is judged only on their own slice, you have individuals working side by side, and no reason for them to help each other when somebody falls behind.", what does "side by side" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: side by side /saɪd baɪ saɪd/ (cụm từ): cạnh nhau (nhưng riêng lẻ). "Work side by side" = làm cạnh nhau; ở đây ngụ ý ngồi gần nhưng không thật sự hợp tác.
items.explanationEn: side by side /saɪd baɪ saɪd/ (phrase): next to each other. "Work side by side" means next to each other; here it implies proximity without real teamwork.

items.question: Trong câu "If each person is judged only on their own slice, you have individuals working side by side, and no reason for them to help each other when somebody falls behind.", từ "slice" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If each person is judged only on their own slice, you have individuals working side by side, and no reason for them to help each other when somebody falls behind.", what does "slice" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a share or portion of the whole
items.explanation: slice /slaɪs/ (danh từ): phần (được chia). "A slice of the work/market" = một phần công việc/thị phần; nghĩa gốc là lát (bánh, thịt).
items.explanationEn: slice /slaɪs/ (noun): a share or portion of the whole. "A slice of the work" means one portion of it; the literal sense is a thin piece of food.

items.question: Trong câu "If each person is judged only on their own slice, you have individuals working side by side, and no reason for them to help each other when somebody falls behind.", từ "fall behind" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If each person is judged only on their own slice, you have individuals working side by side, and no reason for them to help each other when somebody falls behind.", what does "fall behind" (phrase) mean?
options: bị tụt lại, chậm tiến độ
items.explanation: fall behind /fɔːl bɪˈhaɪnd/ (cụm từ): bị tụt lại, chậm tiến độ. "Fall behind (schedule)" = bị chậm so với kế hoạch; trái nghĩa "keep up".
items.explanationEn: fall behind /fɔːl bɪˈhaɪnd/ (phrase): to fail to keep up. "Fall behind schedule" means to be slower than planned; the opposite is "keep up".

items.question: Trong câu "Most project failures get described as "a communication problem", but that diagnosis is too vague to act on.", từ "diagnosis" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most project failures get described as "a communication problem", but that diagnosis is too vague to act on.", what does "diagnosis" (noun) mean?
options: sự chẩn đoán, nhận định nguyên nhân
optionsEn: identifying the cause of a problem
items.explanation: diagnosis /ˌdaɪəɡˈnəʊsɪs/ (danh từ): sự chẩn đoán, nhận định nguyên nhân. "Diagnosis" dùng cả ngoài y tế: nhận định nguyên nhân của vấn đề; động từ "diagnose".
items.explanationEn: diagnosis /ˌdaɪəɡˈnəʊsɪs/ (noun): identifying the cause of a problem. "Diagnosis" is used beyond medicine for identifying a problem's cause; the verb is "diagnose".

items.question: Trong câu "Most project failures get described as "a communication problem", but that diagnosis is too vague to act on.", từ "vague" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Most project failures get described as "a communication problem", but that diagnosis is too vague to act on.", what does "vague" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: vague /veɪɡ/ (tính từ): mơ hồ, không rõ ràng. "Too vague to act on" = quá mơ hồ để hành động; trái nghĩa "specific".
items.explanationEn: vague /veɪɡ/ (adjective): unclear, not specific. "Too vague to act on" means too unclear to guide action; the opposite is "specific".

items.question: Trong câu "More precisely: the right information does not reach the right people while they can still do something about it.", từ "precisely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "More precisely: the right information does not reach the right people while they can still do something about it.", what does "precisely" (adverb) mean?
options: chính xác hơn, cụ thể là
items.explanation: precisely /prɪˈsaɪsli/ (trạng từ): chính xác hơn, cụ thể là. "More precisely" = nói chính xác hơn; dùng để làm rõ một nhận định chung chung.
items.explanationEn: precisely /prɪˈsaɪsli/ (adverb): exactly, to be exact. "More precisely" introduces a sharper version of a general statement.

items.question: Trong câu "A communication plan answers five questions per audience", từ "audience" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A communication plan answers five questions per audience", what does "audience" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a formal meeting with a leader
the group a message is for
items.explanation: audience /ˈɔːdiəns/ (danh từ): nhóm người nhận thông tin. "Target audience" = nhóm đối tượng nhận thông điệp; nghĩa thường gặp khác là khán giả.
items.explanationEn: audience /ˈɔːdiəns/ (noun): the group a message is for. "Target audience" is who a message is aimed at; another common sense is people watching a show.

items.question: Trong câu "Sponsors need risks and decisions; the team needs priorities and blockers", từ "sponsor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sponsors need risks and decisions; the team needs priorities and blockers", what does "sponsor" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: sponsor /ˈspɒnsə/ (danh từ): người bảo trợ dự án. "Project sponsor" = người bảo trợ, cấp ngân sách và quyết định lớn cho dự án.
items.explanationEn: sponsor /ˈspɒnsə/ (noun): the executive backing a project. A "project sponsor" is the senior person who funds and backs a project.

items.question: Trong câu "Sponsors need risks and decisions; the team needs priorities and blockers", từ "blocker" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sponsors need risks and decisions; the team needs priorities and blockers", what does "blocker" (noun) mean?
options: vấn đề cản trở công việc
items.explanation: blocker /ˈblɒkə/ (danh từ): vấn đề cản trở công việc. "Raise a blocker" = báo một vấn đề đang chặn tiến độ, cần người khác gỡ.
items.explanationEn: blocker /ˈblɒkə/ (noun): an issue stopping progress. "Raise a blocker" means reporting something that stops your work and needs someone to remove it.

items.question: Trong câu "Team daily; sponsor fortnightly; customer at each milestone", từ "fortnightly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Team daily; sponsor fortnightly; customer at each milestone", what does "fortnightly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: fortnightly /ˈfɔːtnaɪtli/ (trạng từ): hai tuần một lần. "Fortnight" = hai tuần (Anh-Anh); "fortnightly" = định kỳ hai tuần; Mỹ hay nói "biweekly".
items.explanationEn: fortnightly /ˈfɔːtnaɪtli/ (adverb): once every two weeks. "Fortnight" means two weeks in British English; Americans often say "biweekly".

items.question: Trong câu "Decisions must be written down, even when agreed verbally.", từ "verbally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Decisions must be written down, even when agreed verbally.", what does "verbally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: verbally /ˈvɜːbəli/ (trạng từ): bằng lời nói. "Agree verbally" = thoả thuận miệng; "verbal agreement" dễ bị hiểu khác về sau.
items.explanationEn: verbally /ˈvɜːbəli/ (adverb): by spoken words. "Agree verbally" means by speaking; a "verbal agreement" is easy to remember differently later.

items.question: Trong câu "Not from distrust, but because three months later nobody remembers exactly what was agreed.", từ "distrust" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Not from distrust, but because three months later nobody remembers exactly what was agreed.", what does "distrust" (noun) mean?
options: sự nghi ngờ, thiếu tin tưởng
items.explanation: distrust /dɪsˈtrʌst/ (danh từ): sự nghi ngờ, thiếu tin tưởng. "Out of/from distrust" = vì thiếu tin tưởng; gần nghĩa "mistrust".
items.explanationEn: distrust /dɪsˈtrʌst/ (noun): lack of trust. "From distrust" means because of a lack of trust; "mistrust" is a near synonym.

items.question: Trong câu "Email for bad news creates misreadings and defensiveness.", từ "misreading" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Email for bad news creates misreadings and defensiveness.", what does "misreading" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: misreading /ˌmɪsˈriːdɪŋ/ (danh từ): sự hiểu sai ý. "Misread a message/situation" = hiểu sai tin nhắn/tình huống; tiền tố "mis-" = sai.
items.explanationEn: misreading /ˌmɪsˈriːdɪŋ/ (noun): a wrong interpretation. "Misread a situation" means to interpret it wrongly; the prefix "mis-" means wrongly.

items.question: Trong câu "Email for bad news creates misreadings and defensiveness.", từ "defensiveness" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Email for bad news creates misreadings and defensiveness.", what does "defensiveness" (noun) mean?
options: khả năng phòng vệ quân sự
thái độ phòng thủ, chống chế
items.explanation: defensiveness /dɪˈfensɪvnəs/ (danh từ): thái độ phòng thủ, chống chế. "Get defensive" = phản ứng chống chế khi cảm thấy bị chỉ trích.
items.explanationEn: defensiveness /dɪˈfensɪvnəs/ (noun): a reaction of self-protection. "Get defensive" means reacting to protect yourself when you feel criticised.

items.question: Trong câu "Call first, then send written confirmation.", từ "confirmation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Call first, then send written confirmation.", what does "confirmation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: confirmation /ˌkɒnfəˈmeɪʃn/ (danh từ): sự xác nhận. "Send written confirmation" = gửi xác nhận bằng văn bản; động từ "confirm".
items.explanationEn: confirmation /ˌkɒnfəˈmeɪʃn/ (noun): proof that something is agreed. "Send written confirmation" means putting the agreement in writing; the verb is "confirm".

items.question: Trong câu "Whoever is affected must hear it from you first, not from someone else.", từ "affect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Whoever is affected must hear it from you first, not from someone else.", what does "affect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: affect /əˈfekt/ (động từ): bị ảnh hưởng, tác động. "Be affected by a change" = bị ảnh hưởng bởi thay đổi; đừng nhầm với danh từ "effect".
items.explanationEn: affect /əˈfekt/ (verb): to have an impact on. "Be affected by a change" means the change impacts you; do not confuse it with the noun "effect".

items.question: Trong câu "Every report should carry: where we are, where the trend is heading, which risks are growing, and what you need from the reader.", từ "trend" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every report should carry: where we are, where the trend is heading, which risks are growing, and what you need from the reader.", what does "trend" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: trend /trend/ (danh từ): xu hướng. "The trend is heading up/down" = xu hướng đang đi lên/xuống.
items.explanationEn: trend /trend/ (noun): the general direction of change. "The trend is heading up" describes the general direction things are moving.

items.question: Trong câu "Three reporting failures PMs commonly commit", từ "commit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three reporting failures PMs commonly commit", what does "commit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: commit /kəˈmɪt/ (động từ): phạm phải (lỗi). "Commit a mistake/crime" = phạm lỗi/tội; "commit to a date" = cam kết mốc thời gian.
items.explanationEn: commit /kəˈmɪt/ (verb): to do something wrong. "Commit a mistake" means to make it; "commit to a date" means to promise it.

items.question: Trong câu "No project truly goes from green to red in a week — it was amber for a long time and nobody dared say so.", từ "dare" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No project truly goes from green to red in a week — it was amber for a long time and nobody dared say so.", what does "dare" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: dare /deə/ (động từ): dám (làm gì). "Nobody dared (to) say" = không ai dám nói; "I dare you" = tôi thách bạn (nghĩa khác).
items.explanationEn: dare /deə/ (verb): to be brave enough to. "Nobody dared say" means no one was brave enough; "I dare you" is the challenge sense.

items.question: Trong câu "No project truly goes from green to red in a week — it was amber for a long time and nobody dared say so.", từ "amber" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No project truly goes from green to red in a week — it was amber for a long time and nobody dared say so.", what does "amber" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: amber /ˈæmbə/ (danh từ): màu vàng cam (mức cảnh báo). Trong báo cáo RAG (red-amber-green), "amber" = có vấn đề cần chú ý nhưng còn kiểm soát được.
items.explanationEn: amber /ˈæmbə/ (noun): yellow-orange warning level. In RAG status reporting, "amber" means there is an issue to watch but it is under control.

items.question: Trong câu "Hiding risks to protect appearances.", từ "appearance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hiding risks to protect appearances.", what does "appearance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: appearance /əˈpɪərəns/ (danh từ): thể diện, vẻ bề ngoài. "Keep up/protect appearances" = giữ thể diện, cố tỏ ra mọi thứ ổn.
items.explanationEn: appearance /əˈpɪərəns/ (noun): how things look to others. "Protect appearances" means making things look fine to others regardless of reality.

items.question: Trong câu "An unspoken risk does not disappear; it only loses its chance of early treatment.", từ "unspoken" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An unspoken risk does not disappear; it only loses its chance of early treatment.", what does "unspoken" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unspoken /ʌnˈspəʊkən/ (tính từ): không được nói ra. "An unspoken rule/risk" = quy tắc/rủi ro ai cũng biết nhưng không ai nói ra.
items.explanationEn: unspoken /ʌnˈspəʊkən/ (adjective): not said aloud. "An unspoken rule" is one understood but never stated aloud.

items.question: Trong câu "An unspoken risk does not disappear; it only loses its chance of early treatment.", từ "treatment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An unspoken risk does not disappear; it only loses its chance of early treatment.", what does "treatment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: treatment /ˈtriːtmənt/ (danh từ): sự xử lý, ứng phó. "Risk treatment" = xử lý rủi ro (giảm, tránh, chuyển giao, chấp nhận).
items.explanationEn: treatment /ˈtriːtmənt/ (noun): dealing with a problem. "Risk treatment" means deciding how to handle a risk: reduce, avoid, transfer or accept.

items.question: Trong câu "based on accepted work, plus an updated forecast.", từ "forecast" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "based on accepted work, plus an updated forecast.", what does "forecast" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a prediction of what will happen
items.explanation: forecast /ˈfɔːkɑːst/ (danh từ): dự báo, ước tính. "Updated forecast" = dự báo cập nhật (ví dụ ngày hoàn thành); "weather forecast" = dự báo thời tiết.
items.explanationEn: forecast /ˈfɔːkɑːst/ (noun): a prediction of what will happen. "Updated forecast" is a revised prediction, e.g. of the finish date; also used for weather.

items.question: Trong câu "only those the reader needs, with the action underway.", từ "underway" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "only those the reader needs, with the action underway.", what does "underway" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: underway /ˌʌndəˈweɪ/ (tính từ): đang được tiến hành. "Work is underway" = công việc đang được tiến hành; "get underway" = bắt đầu.
items.explanationEn: underway /ˌʌndəˈweɪ/ (adjective): already in progress. "Work is underway" means it has started and is in progress; "get underway" means to begin.

items.question: Trong câu "A PM who never reports amber has removed their own warning instrument.", từ "instrument" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A PM who never reports amber has removed their own warning instrument.", what does "instrument" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: instrument /ˈɪnstrəmənt/ (danh từ): công cụ. "An instrument for/of change" = công cụ tạo thay đổi; "musical instrument" = nhạc cụ.
items.explanationEn: instrument /ˈɪnstrəmənt/ (noun): a means or tool. "An instrument of change" is a means to achieve it; a "musical instrument" is the other common sense.

items.question: Trong câu "A project that goes amber early and returns to green is a sign of good management, not weakness.", từ "weakness" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A project that goes amber early and returns to green is a sign of good management, not weakness.", what does "weakness" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: weakness /ˈwiːknəs/ (danh từ): sự yếu kém. "A sign of weakness" = dấu hiệu yếu kém; trái nghĩa "strength".
items.explanationEn: weakness /ˈwiːknəs/ (noun): lack of strength or ability. "A sign of weakness" suggests lack of strength; the opposite is "strength".

items.question: Trong câu "Every meeting is an expense: six people for an hour costs six person-hours.", từ "expense" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every meeting is an expense: six people for an hour costs six person-hours.", what does "expense" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: expense /ɪkˈspens/ (danh từ): khoản chi phí. "At the expense of" = đánh đổi bằng; "expense" = khoản tiền/nguồn lực phải bỏ ra.
items.explanationEn: expense /ɪkˈspens/ (noun): a cost you pay. "At the expense of" means at the cost of; an "expense" is something you spend.

items.question: Trong câu "1. Every meeting needs a purpose of one of three kinds: deciding something, solving something, or aligning understanding of something.", từ "purpose" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "1. Every meeting needs a purpose of one of three kinds: deciding something, solving something, or aligning understanding of something.", what does "purpose" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: purpose /ˈpɜːpəs/ (danh từ): mục đích. "Serve a purpose" = có tác dụng; "on purpose" = cố ý.
items.explanationEn: purpose /ˈpɜːpəs/ (noun): the reason for something. "Serve a purpose" means to be useful; "on purpose" means deliberately.

items.question: Trong câu "1. Every meeting needs a purpose of one of three kinds: deciding something, solving something, or aligning understanding of something.", từ "align" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "1. Every meeting needs a purpose of one of three kinds: deciding something, solving something, or aligning understanding of something.", what does "align" (verb) mean?
options: thống nhất, làm cho khớp nhau
items.explanation: align /əˈlaɪn/ (động từ): thống nhất, làm cho khớp nhau. "Get aligned on something" = thống nhất cách hiểu; "align text left" = căn lề trái.
items.explanationEn: align /əˈlaɪn/ (verb): to bring into agreement. "Get aligned on something" means reaching shared understanding; "align text" is the layout sense.

items.question: Trong câu "without being seen as uncooperative.", từ "uncooperative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "without being seen as uncooperative.", what does "uncooperative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: uncooperative /ˌʌnkəʊˈɒpərətɪv/ (tính từ): không hợp tác. Tiền tố "un-" + "cooperative" (hợp tác) = không chịu hợp tác.
items.explanationEn: uncooperative /ˌʌnkəʊˈɒpərətɪv/ (adjective): unwilling to work with others. The prefix "un-" plus "cooperative" gives unwilling to help or work together.

items.question: Trong câu "If only two people genuinely need to discuss it, do not invite four others to listen.", từ "genuinely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If only two people genuinely need to discuss it, do not invite four others to listen.", what does "genuinely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: genuinely /ˈdʒenjuɪnli/ (trạng từ): thật sự. "Genuinely need/care" = thật sự cần/quan tâm; tính từ "genuine" = thật, chân thật.
items.explanationEn: genuinely /ˈdʒenjuɪnli/ (adverb): truly, really. "Genuinely need" means really need; the adjective "genuine" means real or sincere.

items.question: Trong câu "it must be about impediments and flow of work, not each person reporting to the PM.", từ "impediment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "it must be about impediments and flow of work, not each person reporting to the PM.", what does "impediment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: impediment /ɪmˈpedɪmənt/ (danh từ): trở ngại. Trong Scrum, "impediment" = trở ngại khiến đội không tiến được, Scrum Master giúp gỡ bỏ.
items.explanationEn: impediment /ɪmˈpedɪmənt/ (noun): an obstacle. In Scrum, an "impediment" is an obstacle blocking the team that the Scrum Master helps remove.

items.question: Trong câu "Once a daily turns into reporting, the team optimises for sounding good rather than for delivering.", từ "optimise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Once a daily turns into reporting, the team optimises for sounding good rather than for delivering.", what does "optimise" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to make the best of for a goal
items.explanation: optimise /ˈɒptɪmaɪz/ (động từ): hướng tới tối ưu cho. "Optimise for X" = điều chỉnh hành vi để đạt X tốt nhất (thường là thước đo được nhìn thấy).
items.explanationEn: optimise /ˈɒptɪmaɪz/ (verb): to make the best of for a goal. "Optimise for X" means shaping behaviour to maximise X, often whatever is being watched.

items.question: Trong câu "Once a daily turns into reporting, the team optimises for sounding good rather than for delivering.", từ "turn into" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Once a daily turns into reporting, the team optimises for sounding good rather than for delivering.", what does "turn into" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: turn into /tɜːn ˈɪntuː/ (cụm từ): biến thành. "Turn into something" = biến thành cái gì (thường theo hướng không mong muốn).
items.explanationEn: turn into /tɜːn ˈɪntuː/ (phrase): to become, change into. "Turn into something" means to change into it, often in an unwanted way.

items.question: Trong câu "Conflict is NOT a sign of a troubled team — a team that never conflicts has usually stopped speaking honestly.", từ "troubled" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Conflict is NOT a sign of a troubled team — a team that never conflicts has usually stopped speaking honestly.", what does "troubled" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: troubled /ˈtrʌbld/ (tính từ): gặp nhiều trục trặc. "A troubled project/team" = dự án/đội đang gặp nhiều vấn đề.
items.explanationEn: troubled /ˈtrʌbld/ (adjective): having many problems. "A troubled project" is one facing serious problems.

items.question: Trong câu "Distinguish two kinds:", từ "distinguish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Distinguish two kinds:", what does "distinguish" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: distinguish /dɪˈstɪŋɡwɪʃ/ (động từ): phân biệt. "Distinguish A from B / between A and B" = phân biệt A với B.
items.explanationEn: distinguish /dɪˈstɪŋɡwɪʃ/ (verb): to tell apart. "Distinguish A from B" or "between A and B" means to recognise the difference.

items.question: Trong câu "Beneficial — it produces better decisions", từ "beneficial" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Beneficial — it produces better decisions", what does "beneficial" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: beneficial /ˌbenɪˈfɪʃl/ (tính từ): có lợi. "Beneficial to/for someone" = có lợi cho ai; danh từ "benefit".
items.explanationEn: beneficial /ˌbenɪˈfɪʃl/ (adjective): having a good effect. "Beneficial to someone" means good for them; the noun is "benefit".

items.question: Trong câu "Harmful — it destroys collaboration", từ "collaboration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Harmful — it destroys collaboration", what does "collaboration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: collaboration /kəˌlæbəˈreɪʃn/ (danh từ): sự cộng tác. "Close collaboration" = cộng tác chặt chẽ; động từ "collaborate with".
items.explanationEn: collaboration /kəˌlæbəˈreɪʃn/ (noun): working together. "Close collaboration" means working together tightly; the verb is "collaborate with".

items.question: Trong câu "Handle privately, quickly, never let it accumulate", từ "accumulate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Handle privately, quickly, never let it accumulate", what does "accumulate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: accumulate /əˈkjuːmjəleɪt/ (động từ): tích tụ, dồn lại. "Let problems accumulate" = để vấn đề tích tụ dần; danh từ "accumulation".
items.explanationEn: accumulate /əˈkjuːmjəleɪt/ (verb): to build up over time. "Let problems accumulate" means allowing them to pile up; the noun is "accumulation".

items.question: Trong câu "The most common PM mistake: letting relationship conflict persist in the hope it resolves itself.", từ "persist" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most common PM mistake: letting relationship conflict persist in the hope it resolves itself.", what does "persist" (verb) mean?
options: kéo dài, tồn tại dai dẳng
items.explanation: persist /pəˈsɪst/ (động từ): kéo dài, tồn tại dai dẳng. "Let a problem persist" = để vấn đề kéo dài; "persist in doing" = kiên trì làm (nghĩa khác).
items.explanationEn: persist /pəˈsɪst/ (verb): to continue to exist. "Let a problem persist" means letting it continue; "persist in doing" means to keep trying.

items.question: Trong câu "The most common PM mistake: letting relationship conflict persist in the hope it resolves itself.", từ "resolve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most common PM mistake: letting relationship conflict persist in the hope it resolves itself.", what does "resolve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (động từ): được giải quyết. "Resolve itself" = tự được giải quyết; "resolve to do" = quyết tâm làm.
items.explanationEn: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (verb): to be settled. "Resolve itself" means to get settled without action; "resolve to do" means to firmly decide.

items.question: Trong câu "It does not; it mutates into fake task conflict, where two people oppose every proposal the other makes for reasons entirely different from the ones they state.", từ "mutate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It does not; it mutates into fake task conflict, where two people oppose every proposal the other makes for reasons entirely different from the ones they state.", what does "mutate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mutate /mjuːˈteɪt/ (động từ): biến dạng thành. "Mutate into" = biến đổi thành dạng khác (thường tệ hơn); gốc sinh học: đột biến.
items.explanationEn: mutate /mjuːˈteɪt/ (verb): to change form into. "Mutate into" means to change into another, often worse, form; in biology it means genetic change.

items.question: Trong câu "It does not; it mutates into fake task conflict, where two people oppose every proposal the other makes for reasons entirely different from the ones they state.", từ "oppose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It does not; it mutates into fake task conflict, where two people oppose every proposal the other makes for reasons entirely different from the ones they state.", what does "oppose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: oppose /əˈpəʊz/ (động từ): phản đối. "Oppose a proposal" = phản đối đề xuất; "be opposed to" = không đồng ý với.
items.explanationEn: oppose /əˈpəʊz/ (verb): to be against. "Oppose a proposal" means to argue against it; "be opposed to" means to disagree with.

items.question: Trong câu "It does not; it mutates into fake task conflict, where two people oppose every proposal the other makes for reasons entirely different from the ones they state.", từ "proposal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It does not; it mutates into fake task conflict, where two people oppose every proposal the other makes for reasons entirely different from the ones they state.", what does "proposal" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: proposal /prəˈpəʊzl/ (danh từ): đề xuất. "Make/submit a proposal" = đưa ra đề xuất; "marriage proposal" = lời cầu hôn.
items.explanationEn: proposal /prəˈpəʊzl/ (noun): a suggested plan. "Make a proposal" means to suggest a plan; a "marriage proposal" is the other sense.

items.question: Trong câu "Start with a specific observation, not a character judgement.", từ "observation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Start with a specific observation, not a character judgement.", what does "observation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: observation /ˌɒbzəˈveɪʃn/ (danh từ): điều quan sát thấy. "Make an observation" = nêu một điều quan sát được, dựa trên sự kiện cụ thể.
items.explanationEn: observation /ˌɒbzəˈveɪʃn/ (noun): a fact noticed. "Make an observation" means to state something you noticed, based on facts.

items.question: Trong câu "Start with a specific observation, not a character judgement.", từ "judgement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Start with a specific observation, not a character judgement.", what does "judgement" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: judgement /ˈdʒʌdʒmənt/ (danh từ): lời phán xét, đánh giá. "Character judgement" = phán xét tính cách con người; "good judgement" = óc suy xét tốt.
items.explanationEn: judgement /ˈdʒʌdʒmənt/ (noun): an opinion that judges. A "character judgement" labels who someone is; "good judgement" means sound decision-making.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not save it for the quarterly review.", từ "quarterly" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not save it for the quarterly review.", what does "quarterly" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: quarterly /ˈkwɔːtəli/ (tính từ): hằng quý. "Quarterly review/report" = đánh giá/báo cáo hằng quý (ba tháng một lần).
items.explanationEn: quarterly /ˈkwɔːtəli/ (adjective): every three months. "Quarterly review" happens every three months.

items.question: Trong câu "4. End with one concrete change both sides agree to, and a date to review it.", từ "concrete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "4. End with one concrete change both sides agree to, and a date to review it.", what does "concrete" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: concrete /ˈkɒŋkriːt/ (tính từ): cụ thể, rõ ràng. "Concrete action/example" = hành động/ví dụ cụ thể; nghĩa vật liệu: bê tông.
items.explanationEn: concrete /ˈkɒŋkriːt/ (adjective): specific and definite. "Concrete action" means specific and real; the material sense is cement-based building stone.

items.question: Trong câu "When the team is overloaded — this is a PM's problem to resolve rather than the team's to endure:", từ "overload" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When the team is overloaded — this is a PM's problem to resolve rather than the team's to endure:", what does "overload" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: overload /ˌəʊvəˈləʊd/ (động từ): làm quá tải. "Be overloaded with work" = bị quá tải công việc; danh từ "overload".
items.explanationEn: overload /ˌəʊvəˈləʊd/ (verb): to give too much work. "Be overloaded with work" means having more than you can handle.

items.question: Trong câu "When the team is overloaded — this is a PM's problem to resolve rather than the team's to endure:", từ "endure" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When the team is overloaded — this is a PM's problem to resolve rather than the team's to endure:", what does "endure" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: endure /ɪnˈdjʊə/ (động từ): chịu đựng. "Endure pain/pressure" = chịu đựng; "an enduring legacy" = di sản lâu bền (nghĩa khác).
items.explanationEn: endure /ɪnˈdjʊə/ (verb): to put up with hardship. "Endure pressure" means to bear it; "an enduring legacy" uses the sense of lasting.

items.question: Trong câu "That only converts your problem into theirs.", từ "convert" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That only converts your problem into theirs.", what does "convert" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: convert /kənˈvɜːt/ (động từ): biến đổi, chuyển thành. "Convert A into B" = chuyển A thành B; cũng dùng cho đổi đơn vị, đổi tiền.
items.explanationEn: convert /kənˈvɜːt/ (verb): to change into something else. "Convert A into B" means to change A into B; also used for units and currency.

items.question: Trong câu "Make a real decision: cut scope, move the date, or add someone who actually helps.", từ "scope" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Make a real decision: cut scope, move the date, or add someone who actually helps.", what does "scope" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scope /skəʊp/ (danh từ): phạm vi công việc. "Cut scope" = cắt bớt phạm vi; "scope creep" = phạm vi phình ra dần.
items.explanationEn: scope /skəʊp/ (noun): the extent of work included. "Cut scope" means removing features or work; "scope creep" is uncontrolled growth of scope.

items.question: Trong câu "If you can do none of those three, say so plainly and own the consequence", từ "plainly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you can do none of those three, say so plainly and own the consequence", what does "plainly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: plainly /ˈpleɪnli/ (trạng từ): thẳng thắn, rõ ràng. "Say it plainly" = nói thẳng, rõ ràng; "dressed plainly" = ăn mặc giản dị.
items.explanationEn: plainly /ˈpleɪnli/ (adverb): clearly and directly. "Say it plainly" means clearly and directly; "dressed plainly" means simply.

items.question: Trong câu "If you can do none of those three, say so plainly and own the consequence", từ "consequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you can do none of those three, say so plainly and own the consequence", what does "consequence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: consequence /ˈkɒnsɪkwəns/ (danh từ): hậu quả. "Own the consequence" = nhận trách nhiệm về hậu quả; "as a consequence" = do đó.
items.explanationEn: consequence /ˈkɒnsɪkwəns/ (noun): a result of an action. "Own the consequence" means to take responsibility for the result; "as a consequence" means therefore.

items.question: Trong câu "teams can handle a hard truth, but not the feeling of being abandoned.", từ "abandon" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "teams can handle a hard truth, but not the feeling of being abandoned.", what does "abandon" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: abandon /əˈbændən/ (động từ): bỏ rơi. "Feel abandoned" = cảm thấy bị bỏ rơi; "abandon a project" = từ bỏ dự án.
items.explanationEn: abandon /əˈbændən/ (verb): to leave without support. "Feel abandoned" means left alone without support; "abandon a project" means to give it up.

items.question: Trong câu "The precise communication problem is the right information not reaching the right people while they can act.", từ "precise" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The precise communication problem is the right information not reaching the right people while they can act.", what does "precise" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: precise /prɪˈsaɪs/ (tính từ): chính xác, cụ thể. "To be precise" = nói chính xác thì; trạng từ "precisely".
items.explanationEn: precise /prɪˈsaɪs/ (adjective): exact and specific. "To be precise" introduces an exact statement; the adverb is "precisely".

items.question: Trong câu "Assign outcomes, not steps.", từ "outcome" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Assign outcomes, not steps.", what does "outcome" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: outcome /ˈaʊtkʌm/ (danh từ): kết quả đạt được. "Focus on outcomes" = tập trung vào kết quả, không phải cách làm từng bước.
items.explanationEn: outcome /ˈaʊtkʌm/ (noun): the end result. "Focus on outcomes" means caring about results rather than prescribing each step.

items.question: Trong câu "a PM who never uses it has discarded their warning instrument.", từ "discard" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "a PM who never uses it has discarded their warning instrument.", what does "discard" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: discard /dɪˈskɑːd/ (động từ): vứt bỏ, loại bỏ. "Discard changes" = huỷ bỏ thay đổi; "discard an idea" = gạt bỏ ý tưởng.
items.explanationEn: discard /dɪˈskɑːd/ (verb): to throw away. "Discard changes" means throwing them away; "discard an idea" means rejecting it.

items.question: Trong câu "Safety to speak honestly is the foundation, and every other team technique only works once it exists.", từ "foundation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Safety to speak honestly is the foundation, and every other team technique only works once it exists.", what does "foundation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: foundation /faʊnˈdeɪʃn/ (danh từ): nền tảng. "Lay the foundation for" = đặt nền móng cho; "foundation" cũng là quỹ (tổ chức).
items.explanationEn: foundation /faʊnˈdeɪʃn/ (noun): the base everything rests on. "Lay the foundation for" means to prepare the base; a "foundation" can also be a charity.

items.question: Trong câu "When the team is overloaded, the PM must cut scope, move the date, or add help — not ask for more effort.", từ "effort" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When the team is overloaded, the PM must cut scope, move the date, or add help — not ask for more effort.", what does "effort" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: effort /ˈefət/ (danh từ): sự nỗ lực, công sức. "Put in more effort" = bỏ thêm công sức; "effort estimate" = ước lượng công sức.
items.explanationEn: effort /ˈefət/ (noun): hard work and energy. "Put in more effort" means working harder; an "effort estimate" sizes the work needed.
